gloss: there is only; have no choice but to

definitions.gloss: there is only; there is nothing but
definitions.explanation: Attached to a noun or a quantity, it states that nothing else exists and frames the amount as insufficient. {千円|せんえん}しかない means the thousand yen is all there is, and it is not enough.

definitions.gloss: have no choice but to; the only option is to
definitions.explanation: Attached to a plain-form verb, it states that a single course of action remains. It carries resignation: the speaker is not choosing the action so much as running out of alternatives.

examples.english: I only have a hundred yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧しかない⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: There are only two seats, so please come early.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一軒|いっけん}しかなく、⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{閉|し}まって→閉まる：00754_shimaru⟧しまう。
examples.english: There's only one convenience store nearby, and it closes early at night.
There's nothing to do but go for it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧しかない。
examples.english: The trains have stopped, so we have no choice but to walk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧さら⟦{断|ことわ}れない→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧しかないだろう。
examples.english: It's too late to refuse now, so I'll probably just have to take it on.

notes:
しか always pairs with a negative predicate — ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ here — and replaces ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧, ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧, and ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. With other particles it follows them: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧しかない.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Nounしかない: there is only N
- Verb-plainしかない: have no choice but to V
- 〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧しかなかった: there was nothing else to be done

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧: only — neutral counting, no sense of shortage; {百円|ひゃくえん}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ simply reports the amount
- 〜⟦{以外|いがい}→以外：01297_igai⟧にない: there is nothing besides ~ — stiffer and more written
